E1135

`syntax.rewrite` can't call `{replacement}` where `{callee}` was called: {reason}.

What

`syntax.rewrite` can't call `{replacement}` where `{callee}` was called: {reason}.

Why

A rewrite keeps each call's arguments and its use of the result, so the replacement takes what the callee takes and returns what it returns.

Fix

Name a replacement whose parameters and return type match `{callee}`, or drop the `structured_fix`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1135: tests/ui/meta_report_rewrite_refuses_misfit.stderr.

Error [jet.RewriteIncompatible]: `syntax.rewrite` can't call `count` where `print` was called: its argument 1 is `Int` and the call passes `String`
